name: Login Approval
description: Requires TOTP multi-factor authentication on Team Edition after a grace period, emailing users how to turn it on.

settings_schema.header: Users with TOTP multi-factor authentication turned on sign in as usual. Until the cutoff, everyone else signs in with a password and gets a daily reminder email. From the cutoff, their sign-ins are refused and they get an email explaining why.

settings.help_text: Required. RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when sign-ins without TOTP stop working, for example 2026-11-28T22:00:00Z. The plugin will not start without a valid value.
Comma-separated usernames that sign in with only a password and get no emails. Leave empty for none.
